verdict.rationale: Pulley's own product pages say it offers audit-defensible 409A valuations from its expert team, with a three-day turnaround. Nothing shows how the valuation is ordered, whether it draws on live cap table data, or whether refreshes happen on a schedule. Missing for 10: documented in-platform ordering flow, evidence the valuation is generated from live cap table data, recurring/scheduled refresh valuations, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can order an audit-ready 409A valuation in-platform, generated from my live cap table data, and get refreshed valuations on schedule

citations.quote: Get audit-defensible 409A valuations from our team of experts
Pulley’s turnaround time for 409A valuations is just three days—not weeks.
